name: complete-delivery-receipt-ar-process-log
pathSql: SELECT '/api/v2/sales/orders/'||so.id||'/process-log' FROM sal_sales_orders so WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sal_delivery_order_items i JOIN sal_delivery_orders d ON d.id=i.delivery_order_id WHERE i.sales_order_id=so.id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sal_receipts r WHERE r.sales_order_id=so.id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_ar_invoices ar WHERE ar.source_type='SALES_ORDER' AND ar.source_id=so.id AND ar.id=so.ar_invoice_id) ORDER BY so.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST,so.id DESC LIMIT 1;

name: warning-received-without-ar
pathSql: SELECT '/api/v2/sales/orders/'||so.id||'/process-log' FROM sal_sales_orders so WHERE so.status='RECEIVED' AND so.ar_invoice_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_ar_invoices ar WHERE ar.source_type='SALES_ORDER' AND ar.source_id=so.id) ORDER BY so.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST,so.id DESC LIMIT 1;

name: warning-delivery-completed-without-receipt
pathSql: SELECT '/api/v2/sales/orders/'||so.id||'/process-log' FROM sal_sales_orders so JOIN sal_delivery_order_items i ON i.sales_order_id=so.id JOIN sal_delivery_orders d ON d.id=i.delivery_order_id AND d.status='COMPLETED' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sal_receipts r WHERE r.sales_order_id=so.id) ORDER BY so.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST,so.id DESC LIMIT 1;
